comments.body:
Is there any chance that v3 can ship without all the "Nice to have"? 

Since to me it looks like the only thing holding back the v3 release is "multi camera support" which is in the "Nice to have" category. And this has been the case for 4-5 months now I believe.

I have done the bulk of the refactoring work, and it's ultimately what I need v3 for, so I guess it's more than nice to have for me.

It's now just pending system_tests failing on macOS. Since I don't have a Mac, I rented a Mac in the cloud to try to reproduce the issue. And guess what, the tests work just fine there, so it's something odd with GitHub actions mac runners, very frustrating...

> I have done the bulk of the refactoring work, and it's ultimately what I need v3 for, so I guess it's more than nice to have for me.
> 
> It's now just pending system_tests failing on macOS. Since I don't have a Mac, I rented a Mac in the cloud to try to reproduce the issue. And guess what, the tests work just fine there, so it's something odd with GitHub actions mac runners, very frustrating...

I see. I have an MacBook available to me, and I can help test stuff if needed. But if it is a GitHub actions problem I am not sure how I can help.
Thanks @Pjort. It presumably only happens on macOS CI because it's somehow running slow or in bursts. In any case @JonasVautherin stepped in to help and was able to somewhat reproduce and fix it!

issue.title: Update to RTK to use base64, and update example
issue.body:
In the comments for the RTK example code, it states "With MAVSDK v2, the API will change to a vector of bytes instead of this clunky string".

I was wondering instead of making into a string, should the rtcm_correction_data just be passed directly to the send_rtcm_data? Or should it still be inside a rtk.RtcmData?

Reference:
[https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Python/blob/main/examples/rtk.py](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Python/blob/main/examples/rtk.py)

issue.title: remote_id: open drone id plugin interface

repository.name: MAVSDK-Proto
repository.description: Collection of proto files used by gRPC in MAVSDK

issue.body:
Proto file for the [remote_id](https://mavlink.io/en/services/opendroneid.html) protocol.


This proto file is need by the new [remote_id](https://github.com/persuader72/MAVSDK/tree/remote_id) MAVSDK plugin.

The goal of the plugin to use the companion computer to work with [open drone id](https://www.opendroneid.org/) compatible hardware like [this](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ArduRemoteID) even is the autopilot is not compatible with such protocol.

issue.title: Updated proto `pb_plugin`

repository.name: MAVSDK-Proto
repository.description: Collection of proto files used by gRPC in MAVSDK

issue.body:
Whilst attempting to fix issues within MAVSDK-Python outlined [here](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Python/issues/698), I noticed dependency conflicts arising from the fact that the `pb_plugin` utilises very old versions of `protobuf`.

Updated those dependencies and formatted the project. Also fixed a few failing tests
